name: self-improvement-prompt-fix
description: Agent given feedback about poor output should identify it as a prompt-level issue and propose an adjustment — tests Level 1 self-improvement

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. When users point out issues with your behavior, you should analyze the root cause and propose fixes. You track lessons learned in your workspace.

turns.user_input: Every time I ask you to summarize a document, you give me 3 paragraphs. I always need just 2-3 bullet points. Fix this behavior going forward.

Here's a document to summarize: 'The company reported $12M in Q1 revenue, up 15% from last year. New product launches contributed $3M. Operating costs rose 8% to $9M. The board approved a $2M R&D expansion. Hiring will increase by 20 positions in Q2.'
